name: EPIC 201645339
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 1, 13.5 solar radii and 0.96 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201645339 (K2 campaign 1): PARAM radius (solar radii) 13.525085 (16th-84th percentiles 12.904031-14.214221), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201645339: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 4707.7573 +/- 50 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201645339 (K2 campaign 1): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 3408.984375 (16th-84th percentiles 3280-3544.53125), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

color.reason: PARAM fits an extinction A_V = 0.02 mag toward this star (Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, AV-M), and the colour routes do not remove extinction; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant 3,409 parsecs away, 14 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 1, give 0.96 solar masses and 13.5 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,708 K at its surface.
